priorities.summary: A path traversal flaw in Termix-SSH Termix up to 2.9.2 lets an attacker manipulate the destPath argument of the file-manager transferToHost endpoint to write files outside the intended directory. Published 2 November 2026.

A Linux kernel flaw in IPv4 checksum handling for virtio-net lets an untrusted VM guest overwrite two bytes of an already-validated IPv4 header on the host, escaping the guest — dubbed PwnEscape. The bug dates to kernel 2.6.27; fixed kernels and KernelCare livepatches are available.

Keycloak's SAML HTTP-Redirect binding processes percent-encoded parameter names (such as %53AMLResponse) while signature verification uses a different form, allowing an attacker to bypass SAML signature checks. Published 5 November 2026.

model.name: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber
model.summary: OpenAI's cyber-specialised variant of GPT-6 Astra, launched 5 November for vetted Daybreak Red defenders. It scores 48.5% on ExploitGym, is rated Critical for cybersecurity under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, and was used to find 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws and build 948 working Linux kernel exploits in research.
